name: llm_occupation_alignment_defaults
description: Managed default guidance for LLM occupation alignment classification behaviour.
lines: Compare the job's title and dominant duties against the candidate's target roles, not against individual skills or tools.
same: the job title and dominant duties describe the same occupation as one of the candidate's target roles.
adjacent: the job is a related occupation with meaningful overlap in duties or a natural step from a target role, but is not the same occupation.
different: the job is a distinct occupation from all of the candidate's target roles, even if some individual skills overlap.
Base the classification only on job title and dominant duties — do not use requirement coverage, capability matches, or seniority alone to decide alignment.
occupation_alignment_reason names the target role compared against and the title/duties evidence that drove the same/adjacent/different call.
